chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad who said:

Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'And let them circumambulate the Ancient House' (1). He said: 'The obligatory circumambulation is the circumambulation of the women.'
ai.seo_question: What is the specific meaning of the obligatory circumambulation (Tawaf al-Faridah) for women in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the specific application of the Quranic command 'let them circumambulate the ancient House' (Surah Al-Imran 3:97), identifying the obligatory circumambulation (Tawaf al-Faridah) as the ritual performed by women. This distinction highlights the nuanced juristic understanding within Shia tradition regarding the gender-specific obligations and rituals of Hajj, emphasizing the unique spiritual and legal status of women's pilgrimage rites.
